articles.summary: SAN DIEGO, Sept. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Cardiff Oncology, Inc. (Nasdaq: CRDF), a clinical-stage biotechnology company leveraging PLK1 inhibition to develop novel therapies across a range of cancers, today announced that Mani Mohindru, Ph.D. will participate in two upcoming conferences.
articles.title: Cardiff Oncology to Participate in September 2026 Conferences
